UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated player account profile and cloud-synced game favorites, recent history, and launch counts.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name for the player account.

favorites.description: Bounded list of saved game IDs (max 50 items).

recentIds.description: Bounded list of recently played game IDs (max 6 items).

playCounts.description: Map of game ID to integer play count (max 50 entries).

achievements.description: Bounded list of unlocked achievement IDs earned while signed in (max 30 items).

equippedFlair.description: Currently equipped achievement flair ID displayed on the user's name.

coins.description: Spendable arcade and study coins balance (0 to 1,000,000).

lifetimeCoins.description: Cumulative coins earned across sessions (0 to 1,000,000).

unlockedThemes.description: Bounded list of unlocked theme IDs purchased with coins (max 20 items).

hwDone.description: Bounded list of completed homework assignment IDs (max 50 items).

quizCorrect.description: Cumulative count of practice questions answered correctly while signed in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user account document storing profile details and cloud-synced arcade progress.
